purpose: Geometry and visual-reference evidence for prompt design. Examples are not claims that a generated asset is a measured replica.

freefly_alta8_manual.visual_review: Manufacturer cover illustration and specification page 16 inspected; eight motors are documented. The flat multi-boom configuration is a layout example, not a claim that the cargo-drone asset is an ALTA product.
freefly_alta8_manual.scope: Eight-motor radial-layout example; not applicable to coaxial quad layouts or every unnamed UAV.

dji_flycart30.scope: FlyCart 30 uses four coaxial axes with eight rotors. Eight rotors must not be interpreted as eight arms.

dji_m350.scope: Matrice 350 RTK only. A generic Matrice family label does not establish this particular airframe.

franka_hand.visual_review: Official product photograph inspected: compact white housing with two opposed fingers and dark fingertips, separate from the robot arm.
franka_hand.scope: Franka Hand/Panda parallel end-effector form; retain the authored model and requested finger configuration.

ti_package_families.visual_review: Official package gallery inspected, including the distinct DIP lead rows, BGA underside balls and LGA contact lands.
ti_package_families.scope: Package-family geometry. Derive the requested pin count from the item; do not invent a package drawing, pitch or footprint.

lanco_azf.visual_review: Official white shelter photo inspected: opaque continuous skin, defined entrance and side windows. Product description specifies inflatable main arches and possible aluminium spacers.
lanco_azf.scope: Inflatable medical-shelter example; not evidence that an aluminium-frame tent has inflatable arches.

unhcr_family_tent.visual_review: Official general-view floor-plan drawing inspected: rectangular main floor and a separate vestibule at each end. The source explicitly covers the eco-design version without logos.
unhcr_family_tent.scope: Family tent with 16 square metres of main floor plus two vestibules. Preserve the selected specification; other family tents can use other frames.

sprinter_ambulance.scope: Sprinter 907/910 panel-van ambulance example. A family reference does not establish a French Red Cross fleet vehicle or a box-body conversion.

luf60_operator.visual_review: Operator gallery inspected: front and oblique photographs show the large round ventilator, protective fan grille, low red body and two continuous tracks.
luf60_operator.scope: LUF60 tracked vehicle with a large ventilator and water-fog system; not an ordinary wheeled fire engine.

brokk170.visual_review: Manufacturer product photograph inspected: compact tracked base, deployed stabilizers, connected articulated arm and hydraulic breaker. Generic Brokk rows retain their generic identity.
brokk170.scope: Compact tracked demolition robot with articulated tool arm. A Brokk family name alone does not identify the 170 model.

lanco_sg200.visual_review: First-page manufacturer photograph inspected: pitched opaque fabric shelter, front gable entrance, rectangular window panels and continuous lower hem. The following text specifies the aluminium tube frame.
lanco_sg200.scope: Modular medical/accommodation tent example with aluminium tube frame, gable entrance and opaque fabric. The SG200 dimensions do not define the generic large field hospital.

franka_arm.visual_review: Official arm photographs inspected: connected white joint housings and links, mounting structure and separate end-effector. Product text specifies seven degrees of freedom.
franka_arm.scope: Research3 documents seven arm axes; use as an arm-family reference, not an exact Panda product revision or a standalone Hand reference.

ycb_examples.visual_review: Official collection photograph and mustard-bottle/power-drill model examples inspected. The group image distinguishes real packages, vessels, tools, fruit and toys; it does not establish that every manifest item is an exact YCB scan.
ycb_examples.scope: Collection examples only. Match an individual object and source model before claiming a dataset replica; generated geometry and authored dimensions are not dataset ground truth.

nsk_bearing_types.visual_review: Official radial-bearing classification diagrams inspected, including deep-groove and angular-contact bearing sections and the start of the roller-bearing family diagram. Retain the authored specific bearing type.
nsk_bearing_types.scope: Bearing rings, rolling elements and cages; distinguish radial versus thrust and balls versus rollers. No product size or load rating is inferred.
